brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build has one piece: piece:0,0,0;half-s — a single half hex base, no neighbouring bases or stacked pieces

Configurator offers only one drawer per half-base cut face (key n on half-s, key s on half-n). Checked drawers, notches, bays — all return 0 additional sockets after first drawer placed. Full base offers 0 drawer sockets. Maximum achievable under current rules is 1 drawer, not 5. Build currently has 1 drawer: drawer:0#0,0#cut

finish.summary: Single half base with its one achievable drawer placed. Five drawers in a single base is not possible under current configurator rules — half bases allow only one drawer each and full bases allow none, with no additional notch/bay drawers available on an isolated base.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
